WITH ref AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-83.476497 42.394615)', 4326)::geometry AS g
),
nearest AS (
  SELECT r.road_name,
         r.geometry::geometry AS geom,
         ST_Distance(r.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-83.476497 42.394615)', 4326)::geography) AS dist_m
  FROM roads r, ref
  WHERE r.highway = 'cycleway'
    AND r.road_name IS NOT NULL
    AND ST_Dimension(r.geometry::geometry) = 1
    AND ST_NPoints(r.geometry::geometry) BETWEEN 2 AND 50
    AND r.geometry::geometry && ST_MakeEnvelope(-126, 24, -66, 50, 4326)
    AND ST_DWithin(r.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-83.476497 42.394615)', 4326)::geography, 100000)
  ORDER BY r.geometry::geometry <-> ref.g
  LIMIT 1
),
segments AS (
  SELECT (ST_DumpSegments(n.geom)).geom AS seg FROM nearest n
),
endpoints AS (
  SELECT ST_StartPoint(seg) AS p1,
         ST_EndPoint(seg)   AS p2,
         ST_Length(seg::geography) AS seg_len_m
  FROM segments
),
elev AS (
  SELECT e.seg_len_m,
         z1.v AS z1,
         z2.v AS z2
  FROM endpoints e
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, e.p1) AS v
    FROM public.dem_us d
    WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, e.p1)
    LIMIT 1
  ) z1 ON z1.v IS NOT NULL
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, e.p2) AS v
    FROM public.dem_us d
    WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, e.p2)
    LIMIT 1
  ) z2 ON z2.v IS NOT NULL
),
slopes AS (
  SELECT seg_len_m,
         CASE WHEN seg_len_m > 0 THEN ABS(z2 - z1) / seg_len_m ELSE NULL END AS grade
  FROM elev
  WHERE z1 IS NOT NULL AND z2 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT n.road_name,
       n.dist_m,
       DEGREES(ATAN(SUM(grade * seg_len_m) / NULLIF(SUM(seg_len_m), 0))) AS slope_deg
FROM nearest n
CROSS JOIN slopes
WHERE grade IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY n.road_name, n.dist_m;

WITH resort_geom AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-83.476497, 42.394615), 4326)::geography AS resort_point
),
cycleways AS (
  SELECT 
    id, 
    geometry AS cycleway_geom
  FROM 
    roads
  WHERE 
    highway IS NULL 
    AND cycleway IS NOT NULL
),
nearest_cycleway AS (
  SELECT 
    id,
    cycleway_geom,
    ST_Distance(resort_point, cycleway_geom) AS distance_meters
  FROM 
    resort_geom
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT 
        id, 
        geometry AS cycleway_geom
      FROM 
        roads
      WHERE 
        highway IS NULL 
        AND cycleway IS NOT NULL
      ORDER BY 
        resort_point <-> geometry
      LIMIT 1
    ) AS nearest
),
terrain_analysis AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Distance(resort_point, nearest_cycleway.cycleway_geom) AS distance_meters,
    ST_Slope(
      ST_Clip(
        rast, 
        ST_Envelope(ST_Transform(nearest_cycleway.cycleway_geom, 4326)), 
        TRUE
      ), 
      1
    ) AS slope_raster
  FROM 
    resort_geom,
    nearest_cycleway,
    public.dem_us
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(
      rast, 
      ST_Envelope(ST_Transform(nearest_cycleway.cycleway_geom, 4326))
    )
)
SELECT 
  distance_meters,
  ST_Stats(slope_raster).mean AS average_slope_degrees
FROM 
  terrain_analysis;
